clips.title: The story
paras: The Tkashi Ruins are ancient stone remnants situated southwest of Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Overrun by hostile Bloodscalp trolls, the site remains a stronghold of the tribe.

Perched southwest of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting camp, the crumbling stone masonry of the Tkashi Ruins marks the ancient domain of Stranglethorn's jungle trolls. Today, the encampment is heavily occupied by the Bloodscalp tribe, who aggressively defend the territory and practice their shamanistic rituals among the vines and decayed stone. While Hemet Nesingwary noted passing through the ruins without trouble in his hunting memoirs, modern travelers find the trolls far less accommodating, guarding valuable tribal relics buried among the rubble.
